reconciliation_explanation.note: 37,909 total issues touching eligible sprints minus 354 status-less issues in those sprints = 37,555 issues with status changelogs.

row_increase_explanation.explanation: Although 17,171 issues appeared in sprint changes, most were already completed before the snapshot timestamps, or were moved to the backlog/another sprint before the snapshot point t, or belonged to sprints outside the replay windows. Only 2688 omitted issues were actively open during snapshot checkpoints, while 329 status-less issues were removed to eliminate leakage. Net issue gain was 2359 (+11.37%), which yielded 7668 (+9.03%) additional snapshot rows.
